event: Daily Intelligence Briefing
title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Tech cracked, defensives bid, small caps held.
SOXX -3.35% against XLP +2.11% is a high-to-low rotation, not a risk-off day: 337 of 500 S&P names rose while QQQ fell 1.34%. The catalysts were cooler data — jobless claims 19.7 vs 20 fc, trade deficit -1056 vs -1020 fc — plus a 5.3% 10-year auction tailing 4.83% prior, which hit rate-sensitive tech hardest while bid the long end (TLT +0.94%).

INDICES — VIX 15.4, still below its 20-day 15.7.
GLD +0.73%, RSP +0.60%, DIA +0.12%, IWM -0.05%, SPY -0.42%, QQQ -1.34%, SOXX -3.35%. Small > large by 0.59pp. Most notable cross-asset move: WTI +2.55% on the -318.6 crude draw. No 200-DMA breach flagged.

VOLUME & BREADTH — SPY vol_ratio 0.9x, QQQ 1.5x.
SPY's 0.9x on -0.42% is quiet drift; QQQ's 1.5x on -1.34% is distribution into tech. SOXX 1.6x and RSP 1.7x show attention went to semis sellers and equal-weight buyers. Breadth diverges from the headline: 68% advancers, up/down vol 1.51, but only 32% above the 50-DMA and 46% above the 200-DMA — a bounce under a damaged surface.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLP Staples +2.11%, XLF Financials +0.89%, XLRE Real Estate +0.69%, XLB Materials +0.59%, XLI Industrials +0.33%, XLY Discretionary +0.31%, XLC Comms +0.00%, XLE Energy +0.00%, XLU Utilities -0.19%, XLV Healthcare -0.39%, XLK Technology -1.79%.
Top industries XOP +2.79%, USO +2.55%; bottom DRAM -5.13%, WGMI -6.40%. Flows contradict price: XLK took +$1,771mm (100th pct) while leading losses, XLU +$2,313mm (100p) and XLC +$960mm (98p) — dip-buying into strength, not short-covering. Confusing tape; net call = narrow mega-cap tape.

POSITIONING — QQQ PCR 1.05 and skew +6.0% show real hedging demand; SPY PCR 0.96, skew +4.0%.
VIX 15.4 sits under its 20-day 15.7, so no panic. VIXEQ 39.8 vs VIX 15.4 — a 24-point gap = extreme single-stock dispersion, low implied correlation.

CROSS-ASSET — Crude's -318.6 inventory draw lifted WTI +2.55% while the 10-year auction at 5.3% pressured duration-sensitive tech and lifted TLT +0.94% — a clean growth-to-cash rotation.
Next FOMC Oct 28; Polymarket prices 84% no change, 16% for a 25bp hike (+2pp in 5 days).

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 55.9, Neutral.
Movers: VST -6.35%, ORCL -5.48%, INTC -5.34%, MDT +2.62% (vol 5.2x). Worst 20d sector XLK +6.78% still positive; watch UTES vol 3.7x on -1.83% — distribution. Watch XLK (200-DMA test), INTC (third straight down day), PEP vol 2.5x +3.73% (staples rotation confirmation).
